businesses.name: Even Though I'm Blind, Inc.
businesses.summary: Even Though I'm Blind, Inc. supports the blind and visually impaired community through accessible media, advocacy, storytelling, and community-centered opportunities.
businesses.description: Even Though I'm Blind, Inc. supports the blind and visually impaired community by creating accessible media, advocacy, storytelling, and community-centered opportunities that amplify real voices and lived experiences. Through radio, podcasts, educational content, events, and outreach, ETIB promotes visibility, empowerment, inclusion, and leadership while helping reshape how the world understands blind and visually impaired people.
businesses.spokenSummary: Even Though I'm Blind, Inc. is a nonprofit media and advocacy organization empowering the blind and visually impaired community through accessible storytelling, media, outreach, and inclusive opportunities.
businesses.blindCommunitySupport: ETIB creates platforms where blind and visually impaired people can share their experiences, find useful information, build connections, and access opportunities without being framed through pity.
businesses.accessibility: ETIB offers screen-reader-friendly digital platforms, audio-based media, clear communication, and accessibility-centered outreach designed to reduce barriers to information and participation.

businesses.name: Liner Legal
businesses.summary: Liner Legal is a disability law firm and ETIB community resource for people exploring Social Security Disability and Long-Term Disability options.
businesses.description: Liner Legal, founded by Michael Liner, provides disability-law information and legal services related to Social Security Disability Insurance, Supplemental Security Income, and Long-Term Disability matters. Liner Legal shared a short eligibility survey with Even Though I'm Blind, Inc. as part of a resource collaboration to help visitors determine whether they may qualify for an initial conversation about disability benefits.
businesses.spokenSummary: Liner Legal is a disability law firm that provides information and legal services related to Social Security Disability, Supplemental Security Income, and Long-Term Disability benefits.
businesses.blindCommunitySupport: This listing gives blind and visually impaired people a direct starting point for exploring disability-benefit questions and connecting with a disability-law firm. ETIB shares the resource for information and access; Liner Legal independently handles eligibility review, legal advice, and representation decisions.
businesses.accessibility: Visitors can use the linked online eligibility survey and Liner Legal website to begin. People who need an accessible alternative or communication accommodation should contact Liner Legal directly at (216) 282-1773 or through linerlegal.com.

location.remoteDetails: Online and telephone communication available through Liner Legal.
